avis.texte: This toner feels really refreshing and gives my skin a nice boost of hydration. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without leaving any sticky residue. I like that it has hyaluronic acid and ceramides because my skin feels softer and more balanced after using it. It also feels calming when my skin is irritated or a little red. The only downside is the bottle can dispense a bit too much product if I’m not careful. It layers well under serums and moisturizer and doesnt cause any pilling. Overall its a gentle hydrating toner that works well for everyday use.

I've used a lot of toners over the years and I'm so happy that hydrating/moisturizing toners are a thing now instead of the godawful alcohol/witch hazel ones that used to be pushed. This toner is great! It gives me a light level of hydration, is soothing, and doesn't leave any stickiness behind. There's no strong/lingering smell and it goes on nice and smooth and absorbs quickly. It's currently listed at $19 which is a fantastic price.
Seguramente, es bueno, Pero no para piel madura, ni mixta. Lastima
This product does the job, doesn’t irritate or dry out my skin, is affordable and environmentally friendly
Great, do not need a cream at least during summer! EWG approved

I like the ingredients list but this has failed to keep my face hydrated. It also takes a long time to absorb into the skin. Maybe good for oily skin but not combo or dry. I also used other moisturizering products and my face was not glowing as usual. I also felt dry spots where I had to go back and add additional layer of moisturizer.

avis.titre: Smoother face and less oily skin
avis.texte: My experience using this toner over the last 2 weeks was very positive. I'm surprised how well it actually worked. My face always started to become oily by the time noon rolled around. After my first application, I noticed that my face was less greasy and my pores have shrunk significantly. I could rub my hand over my cheeks at the end of the day without it being covered in oil. Over time, my skin looked and felt much smoother and some of my blemishes from some old pimples faded away much quicker than before. The product was very light and mild with almost no scent at all. There was no burning sensation or irritation when applied over a pimple. There was a very slight sticky feel to my face while it was still wet, but it pretty much went away once fully dried. The bottle and even the cap had a premium-feeling to it. It somehow survived shipping even though the box was dented and mangled.

avis.titre: Solid Product With Great IngredientsSolid Product With Great Ingredients
avis.texte: I ordered this toner because the brand/product gave me Dr. Jart+ vibes (specifically, their CicaPair line). The ingredients are almost all excellent. The packaging is a heavy frosted glass bottle; it feels fancy. It’s good for a “shelfie”, if that’s your thing. I use a cotton square to apply it. I wouldn’t say it’s worked miracles since I began using it about two months ago, but I’m happy to have it in my rotation of skincare products. Skincare products obviously vary in price enormously. The price for this toner is about average/fair compared to similar ones on Amazon ($20 for one 6.76 oz. bottle at the time of writing this review). Overall, I’m enjoying using this so far and would definitely recommend!

Super moisturizing! Functions more like a serum than a toner, but weightless and non-greasy. Been using for a few days and I can already tell that my skin is more moisturized and supple, almost toned. Very happy with this product!
It works great! It’s easy to absorb and it doesn’t leave anything but receptive skin. The aroma is good.

avis.titre: Refreshing toner , good for daily use.
avis.texte: I've been using Korean premium lotions and toners as moisturizers for quite some time, and they've worked really well for me. I’m excited to try this product because I like the texture (but it is slightly watery than what I anticipated, and the added tea tree ceramide is a nice bonus. Since the weather is a bit chilly right now, I mix this toner with aquaphor to make it slightly thicker, then apply it to my face. I love this combo, and my skin feels super hydrated and soft afterward. I wish it is just a bit thicker thats all.

avis.titre: works well, scent free, good ingredients
avis.texte: This Moisture Dr. toner is loaded with the kind of stuff that is good for your skin.It comes in an attractive frosted bottle that looks nice on the shelf, too. I really like that it is scent free unlike some other toners. It is not oily, and applies smoothly without leaving any noticeable residue. I've been using it a few days now. It seems to do a good job and I've experienced no problems with it at all. It leaves my skin feeling clean.
